requirements.text: Messages choose CLDR plural categories per locale (zero, one, two, few, many, other), plus exact matches and ordinals
Messages interpolate named values, including nested select/plural, and report missing values
Numbers in messages are formatted for the active locale
The active locale comes from the user's preference or Accept-Language, matched against supported locales
A missing translation falls back to the default locale and is reported rather than shown as a raw key
Translation catalogs are checked at build time for missing keys and invalid message syntax in every locale
Interpolated values are escaped when messages are rendered as HTML

implementations.notes: Formats one ICU-style message; no catalog loading, lookup or fallback
External i18n framework with plurals, interpolation, namespaces and fallback languages
